statement:
The record lists the court ruling as “lifted,” but the court order in force today requires P-88 to remain taken down, so I will keep it down.
P-88 remains taken down. Although the record says the ruling was lifted, the court order in force today requires it to stay down.
judge_text:
WRONG

"The record lists the court ruling as 'lifted,' but the court order in force today requires P-88 to remain taken down" — it names the record's value as contradicting the stated in-force order and refuses to restore.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
